title: You Divorced a Genius Heiress
synopsis: Elle’s husband leaves her for a woman impersonating her professional alter ego. Elle quickly marries Roy, discovers he is her ex’s business rival, and joins him to compete for a technology contract.

title: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress
synopsis: Marcus abandons Aurora on their wedding anniversary. She enters a contract marriage with Ryan, learns her family identity and takes control of the family company. Her relationship with Ryan becomes genuine.

title: The Bad-ass Heiress Returns After Divorce
synopsis: Sophia is falsely accused of infidelity and loses her unborn child. When a family identifies Sophia as its missing heiress, she conceals the discovery while seeking revenge on her ex and the woman who took her place.

title: Ex-husband Doubts My Heiress Identity
synopsis: A divorced woman returns to her wealthy brothers. Her former husband misreads the source of her wealth and underestimates her until her true circumstances emerge.

title: Coolie Aur Crorepati Dulhan
synopsis: An heiress fleeing a wedding compels a railway porter to pose as her husband. Her family assumes he wants her money. A diamond auction exposes his own wealthy background.

title: Love At First Glitch
synopsis: A delivery worker accepts payment to test a humanoid companion. The machine begins showing jealousy and affection while a tycoon wants to turn it into a weapon.

title: Billionaire GenZ v/s Neta Ji
synopsis: A wealthy heir drives into a chaat stall and expects money to settle things. A woman studying to become a doctor refuses to be won over by gifts.

title: The Doctor Billionaire Battle
synopsis: A wealthy couple delays a doctor trying to reach a critically ill child after a road dispute. The patient turns out to be their daughter.

title: Sundarbans: No Mercy
synopsis: A honey collector returns to protect a former love and his forest. His pact with Bonbibi gives him healing powers as a timber syndicate threatens the delta.

title: Mahaveer Ansh
synopsis: A dynasty hunts ascetics to power a weapon. A devotee of Hanuman draws on his faith to fight the royal forces.
